description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing MobileAppBundleEntity entities, including custom queries for retrieving and deleting mobile app bundle data based on tenant ID, bundle ID, package name, and platform type.

classes.name: MobileAppBundleRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for MobileAppBundleEntity with custom query methods for retrieving and deleting mobile app bundle data.

methods.name: findInfoByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of MobileAppBundleInfoEntity objects filtered by tenant ID and optional search text.

methods.name: findInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info of a mobile app bundle by its ID.

methods.name: findByPkgNameAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds a MobileAppBundleEntity by package name and platform type.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of MobileAppBundleEntity objects filtered by tenant ID and optional search text.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all mobile app bundles associated with a specific tenant ID.
